references.text: Jesus commands the disciples to baptize in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, which underscores the importance of baptism as mentioned in Mark 16:16.
Peter tells the people to repent and be baptized in Jesus' name for the forgiveness of sins, which resonates with faith and baptism for salvation in Mark 16:16.

Paul and Silas tell the jailer that he and his household will be saved if they believe in the Lord Jesus, and they are baptized, which reflects the role of faith and baptism in salvation as mentioned in Mark 16:16.
It is emphasized that without faith it is impossible to please God, which corresponds with the importance of faith for salvation in Mark 16:16.
